items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Parses passport JSON ({identity, snapshots[]}) and outputs individual fields as Grasshopper-native types. Reconstructs geometry, bounding boxes, PCA frames, and metadata from the identity/snapshot pair. Point clouds prefer the full PLY via Session cache, then the inline preview.
